Done. The full suite is green (57 tests, 0 failures).

## What I changed

The create audit line lives in a single OfficeFloor step, `AuditOwnerCreated.service(...)`, which runs after `SaveOwner` in the `POST /api/owners` pipeline. I extended its `AUDIT` log statement to also emit `membershipNumber` alongside the fields it already logged (`id`, `customerCode`, `registrationDate`, `membershipLevel`):

```java
AUDIT.info(
        "Owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={} membershipNumber={}",
        owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(),
        Membership.levelOf(owner), owner.getMembershipNumber());
```

The `membershipNumber` is already assigned earlier in the pipeline (`assignMembershipNumber` step, before `save`/`audit`), so it's populated by the time this step runs. I also updated the class Javadoc to mention the added field.

The new `Cp43Tests.coreAuditIncludesLevelAndNumber` passes, and the existing audit test (`Cp21Tests`) — which matches on substrings and only asserts on fields still present — remains green.
